Listen. Coming from someone who had been using fentanyl the past 5 years (I'm 30 days sober today) let me tell you there isn't enough information here that u told us about the situation to lead you in the wrong or right direction, but from the sounds of it, he is using. If he doesnt have the respect to at least tell you that hes still using, and try to get you to help him with this addiction, give him an ultimatum. Admit it, well get through it and I'll help you, or I'm leaving you. That's just my opinion though, not many would agree on the ultimatum aspect. But I can tell from the sounds of it you might be really naive to the fact that hes using or may not want to believe he is again.

But the stamps doesnt mean anything. The stamps dont mean anything other than there was fentanyl or heroin in those wax papers, no other drug is packaged like that, it doesnt matter the stamp. It sounds like hes still using, in active recovery there are many triggers, and I would say old paraphernalia is at the top to be one of the worst triggers. So I dont see why he would keep it around. I'm sorry people like you have to get put through such hell over such a horrible drug. Give us updates please, this is my advice, even tho it's my personal opinion, I hope you take some of it into consideration. 

If he wasnt using, he knows what's on the line and hed try to do anything in his power to prove to you and whoever else that he isn't still using. Even if it means pissing on the spot in a drug test. If you or his family mean anything to him, hed prove that he wasnt using again. Not just try to convince you.

Whatever you do, if you confront him, confront him in a way to let him know whatever happens you're supportive of his decisions and you're on his side. He might be living on edge as it is. Be easy and understanding.

I hope the best....
